consolidation_layers.question: What invariant rules must implementations obey?
What subtype/domain-specific mechanism is being studied?
How is the same operator shown to a reader?
Where is duplication or orphan pressure?

immediate_merge_queue: Public projection audit: continue converting page-local ontology into canonical owner links and shared runtimes.
Legacy master audit: identify older files that still declare generic canonical authority despite newer House/operator ownership.
Promotion-status system: mark recovery/research waves unpromoted, partially promoted, absorbed/provenance-only or still source-bearing.
Site build/CI audit: keep all public, scientific, SEO, map and House validators green after ontology expansion.
Only then consider moving fully absorbed temporary/recovery files to archive.
success_metrics: One obvious definition/contract owner for every high-frequency operator.
Every specialist names the owner it specializes instead of repeating a generic definition.
Every research synthesis preserves provenance links to source/specialist owners.
Every public projection can be replaced without changing canonical ownership.
New files are created only when they add a distinct schema, mechanism, evidence layer, timeline or reader function.
